summary: Backend-only regression testing for v2.3.3 false-positive CHARGED fix. All 3 new tests in test_fake_charge_dropped.py pass, plus all 36 pre-existing tests in the requested suite (39/39). Added 9 additional edge-case tests in /app/backend/tests/test_fake_charge_edge_cases.py — all pass. Guard correctly rejects empty card, whitespace-only card, non-numeric short strings ('unknown'), <12-digit cards, LIVE with no card, amount=0/None/'0.00' — and correctly LETS DEAD pass (not forwardable) and legit CHARGED pass (real card + non-zero amount, including amount as string '$14.50').
critical_code_review_comments: Guard logic is solid: `len(number.replace(' ', '')) < 12` combined with `_extract_card` already stripping spaces gives coverage for whitespace/short/non-numeric card numbers. Amount coercion in the Pydantic validator handles '$14.50', '0.00', None consistently.
Minor: the 12-digit minimum will accept 12-15 digit garbage strings like '123456789012' as long as amount > 0. Consider a Luhn check as a follow-up (not blocking).

The guard runs BEFORE the dedup check and BEFORE DB insert / counter increment — correct order (drop == no side effects). Verified via test results (forwarded:false, dropped:'no_card'/'zero_amount', no hitId).
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.3.3 no_card/zero_amount guard in /app/backend/routes/data.py::submit_status is fully covered by tests/test_fake_charge_dropped.py (3) + tests/test_fake_charge_edge_cases.py (9). All 39 originally-requested tests still green — no regressions.
rca of the issue: Random sites (e.g. hyper3d.com) return gateway-like JSON with status:succeeded but no card entry, tripping the extension's PAYMENT_RESULT observer. Fix is two-layered: (a) extension requires valid card + recent fill on the tab; (b) backend refuses forwardable hits with empty/short card (<12 digits) or CHARGED with amount<=0. Tested layer (b) exhaustively.
